# Step 10: Phase 2, unsupervised-capable

*Outline. Designed after step 9 runs for a few weeks.*

- Charging dock with AprilTag, ArduPilot Dock mode, 36 V charger with pogo contacts.
- Raspberry Pi 5 companion (ROS 2): global-shutter camera for the dock, OAK-D Lite or radar for obstacle stops, speed-up to 1.0 m/s once obstacle sensing works.
- Deck on the robot pack (if T1 allowed it) so the dock recharges everything.
- Second deck (twin configuration) if the measured hours call for it.
